mapping.draft_py:
# Daggersail Aeronaut: "During your turn, this creature has flying."  (Radha template B5a-radha-first-strike)
flying_on_my_turn = StaticAbility(
    effect=A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
        'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.FLYING),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
    condition=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TURN_OF, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
)
abilities = [flying_on_my_turn, *compiled]

clauses.clause: During your turn, this creature has flying.

mapping.notes: Radha template (B5a-radha-first-strike) with FLYING: StaticAbility GRANT_ABILITY on self, condition TURN_OF YOU. Probe: flying on own turn (giant cannot block), lost on the opponent's turn.
